_meta.purpose: Maps engine ability commands (data/abilities.json) to the families the brain has logic for. Exact command match, never substring.
_meta.policy: A command that is in the registry but in no auto_use family is NEVER used automatically. auto_use=false families are documented, not wired.
_meta.history: Replaces the keyword lists of find_ready_ability (HANDOFF issue 52). The old lists matched by substring on display names: 'charge' also matched Discharge, RechargeObject, ToggleProvideCharge and 'Lase (4 charges)'; 'teleportation' matched nothing (the mutation's command is CommandTeleport); 'disarm' and 'chain fire' match no real ability.

risk: light damage burns corpses (no butchering) and can ignite plants
fire: ignites plants, the campfire death

disarming_shot.note: No such activated ability exists in the game data; the old keyword never matched anything.

chain_fire.note: No such activated ability exists in the game data; the old keyword never matched anything.

teleport_self.note: The Teleportation mutation. The old code looked for 'teleportation' and never matched it, so it was never used. Wiring it needs the cell picker path tested in game first.

phase_toggle.note: Phasing toggle. Needs untoggle logic before it can be used safely.

burrowing.note: Burrowing Claws and Dig: BACKLOG B7. A burrowed character cannot do some things or travel far.

toggle_decapitate.note: A toggle, not a strike. The old 'decapitate' keyword wrongly treated it as one.

clairvoyance.note: Reveals a map region; deliberately not combat.
